data.title: Data
data.body1: Hachibu works without an account — your data is stored only on this device. Deleting the app or switching phones will erase your meal logs, weight, and body fat records.
data.body2: Subscriptions are tied to your Apple ID / Google Account. You can restore a previous purchase from the Subscription screen after reinstalling.
data.resetMessage: All data stored on this device — including your profile, goals, weight, body fat, and meal logs — will be permanently deleted. Continue?

widget.title: Log in one tap from your home screen
widget.body: No need to open the app

basis.title: Biological Reference
basis.subtitle: Used to estimate body fat % and calorie targets

height.title: What's your height?
height.subtitle: Used to calculate your calorie needs

weight.title: Current weight?

age.title: How old are you?

activity.title: What's your daily routine like?
activity.subtitle: Estimates daily metabolism from work and daily movement
activity.note: Exercise logged separately is automatically added to your daily goal. Select only your everyday lifestyle pattern here.

Sedentary.label: Desk / Remote Work
Sedentary.hint: Mostly sitting — WFH, office, computer work

ModeratelyActive.label: Active Job
ModeratelyActive.hint: Nursing, sales, delivery — lots of walking

currentBody.title: Which looks closest to you now?
currentBody.subtitle: Choose the body type that best matches on two axes: fat and muscle. Selecting one auto-fills your estimated body fat %.

direction.title: How do you want to change?
direction.subtitle: Used to suggest a plan. You can change this anytime.

recomp.label: Recomposition
recomp.hint: Same weight — swap fat for muscle

plan.maintainNote: No pace needed — here's your maintenance target.
plan.reachHint_yes: On track for target body type

preview.title: Your Goal
preview.subtitle: You can always adjust this from My Status.
